title: Conversation and session source intake adapter
objective: Add a tested, local-export-only intake adapter so owner-supplied ChatGPT conversation exports and project transcript files can be preserved byte-for-byte in a private vault and represented by privacy-minimized source metadata in the public VAIXLNS repository.
forbidden_paths: .github/workflows/** (except the exact new workflow path above)
allowed_operations: Create the listed adapter, schema, tests, documentation, taxonomy metadata and one isolated CI workflow on this feature branch.
Read existing source files and repository metadata.
Run deterministic local unit tests against synthetic fixtures only.
forbidden_operations: Do not modify main or any protected branch.
Do not upload real conversation exports, user attachments, transcripts, titles, message content, credentials or personal data to this public repository.
Do not connect to or scrape ChatGPT account/session APIs.
Do not alter Git hooks, repository secrets, branch protection, permissions or Git configuration.
Do not delete, rename, overwrite or deduplicate historical source files.
Do not create canonical IDs for extracted entities or promote records to IMPLEMENTED/VERIFIED/CANONICAL.
Do not merge the pull request or deploy the website.
acceptance_criteria: The adapter accepts owner-supplied ChatGPT conversations.json, ZIP exports containing exactly one conversations.json, UTF-8 TXT/MD transcript files and opaque binary source files.
Original source bytes are preserved unchanged in a vault that must be outside every Git checkout.
All conversation mapping nodes and parent/child branches are retained; no branch is flattened or discarded.
Default mode is dry-run; persistence requires explicit --apply.
Public manifests omit source filenames, titles, user identifiers and message content.
Unsupported or malformed content fails closed or is recorded as opaque/quarantined; no silent partial parse is claimed.
Repeated ingestion is idempotent and immutable destination collisions fail closed.
Synthetic unit tests cover parsing, branch preservation, ZIP path traversal safety, privacy minimization, dry-run, idempotency and vault boundary enforcement.
Documentation distinguishes this local export adapter from a live ChatGPT connector and explains that complete history requires an owner-supplied export.
No canonical promotion or production-readiness claim is made.
rollback: Close the unmerged PR or revert only this feature branch. Never delete user source files or vault contents.
required_review: Independent VV review of the exact diff and test evidence. If unavailable, verdict remains NOT_VERIFIED.
